about.title: Her Story
about.intro: Drawing since four, tattooing professionally since sixteen. Now 44, with nearly three decades immersed in the craft — traditional Japanese irezumi, tattoo flash, and vibrant character illustration for the digital age.
about.milestone1Desc: Picked up a pencil at age four. Drawing became the language before words.
about.milestone2Desc: Began tattooing professionally at sixteen. The craft chose her early.
about.milestone3Desc: Embraced digital illustration, bringing traditional sensibilities to character design and VTuber art.
about.milestone4Desc: Nearly 30 years in the craft. Still learning, still evolving. Traditional irezumi meets Reiwa-era storytelling.
about.mediumsDesc: Digital illustration, pencil sketching, and traditional tattoo technique.
about.digitalDesc: Procreate and Clip Studio Paint for character design, VTuber models, and commissioned artwork. Vibrant colors, clean linework.
about.pencilDesc: Pencil on paper for initial concepts, tattoo flash designs, and exploration. The foundation of every piece.
about.tattooDesc: Machine tattooing with traditional irezumi composition. Bold black work, mythological subjects, full coverage.
about.philosophyDesc: Every piece bridges two worlds: the dense black linework and mythological vocabulary of Edo-period irezumi, and the bright, saturated energy of contemporary character design. It's not fusion — it's conversation.
about.processDesc: Every tattoo begins with research, sketching, and refinement before it touches skin.
about.processStep1Desc: Initial sketches exploring composition, subject matter, and client vision. References from Edo-period ukiyo-e and contemporary sources.
about.processStep2Desc: Clean line drawing with final composition locked. Traditional black and red palette finalized for flash work.
about.processStep3Desc: Completed piece ready for skin or digital delivery. Full shading, detail work, and signature hanko seal applied.

commissions.faq1Q: How long does a tattoo session take?
commissions.faq1A: Session length depends on piece size and complexity. Small pieces may take 2-3 hours, while larger work can span multiple 4-6 hour sessions. We'll discuss timing during consultation.
commissions.faq2A: Yes. A 50% deposit is required to secure your appointment and begin design work. Deposit is non-refundable but can be applied to future sessions if rescheduled with notice.
commissions.faq3A: Please provide at least 48 hours notice for cancellations or rescheduling. Last-minute cancellations may forfeit the deposit.
commissions.faq4A: Currently booking by appointment only. Flash designs may be available for walk-ins during special events — follow X/Twitter for announcements.
commissions.faq5A: Full aftercare instructions provided after each session. Keep it clean, moisturized, and out of direct sunlight for 2-3 weeks. No swimming or soaking.
commissions.faq6A: Absolutely! References help communicate your vision. Feel free to share photos, sketches, or mood boards during your inquiry.
